personality_one_liner: Energetic, highly visible, and tactile tracking utility that uses bold adaptive colors to make document management feel alive and urgent.

spacing.rule: Generous tonal spacing around cards to allow colors to pop without crowding. Use md/lg padding heavily.

do's: Apply frosted glass to the bottom tab bar so scrolling documents glide underneath.
Apply glass to the sticky top header (Evidencija dokumenata).
Use glass on the 'Active Subscription' hero pill if placed over the passport hero image.
dont's: Do not blur individual document cards in the list.
Do not use glass for text inputs or forms.

screens.name: Home (Документа)
screens.purpose: Primary dashboard displaying the user's active documents, remaining validity days, and subscription status.

states.empty: Illustration of an open passport or clean desk, text 'Немате додатих докумената' (No documents added), and a primary 'Додај документ' button.
states.error: Text 'Грешка при учитавању' (Error loading) with a retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with app title. Below header, a full-width featured hero section or pill showing 'Претплата важи до: [Datum]' on a warning/yellow background. Followed by a masonry or single-column list of document cards. Cards are surfaceSecondary, with an icon in a brandTertiary circle. Each card features a bold status chip for days remaining: 2 days (error), 5 days (warning), 10 days (info), 15 days (success). Fixed FAB for adding new documents above the tab bar.

screens.name: Add Document (Додај)
screens.purpose: Form to create a custom named document card and select the expiry alarm threshold.
screens.layout: Single column form inside a KeyboardAvoidingView. Input for Document Name (Назив). Date picker for Expiry Date (Важи до). A prominent segmented control or row of touchable pills for the alarm selector: 'Обавести ме за:' [2 дана] [5 дана] [10 дана] [15 дана]. Sticky primary CTA at the bottom: 'Сачувај документ'.

screens.name: Subscription (Претплата)
screens.purpose: Details the 4 EUR / 6-month subscription, payment instructions via IBAN, and proof-of-payment upload.
screens.layout: Hero image (wallet/folder) with a gradient scrim. High-contrast typography detailing '4€ / 6 месеци'. A surfaceTertiary card with IBAN details (LU8240...). A primary CTA to 'Учитај доказ о уплати' (Upload proof of payment).

screens.name: Admin Panel (Админ)
screens.purpose: Dashboard for admins to manage users, confirm payments, and view statistics.

states.empty: No pending payments or users found.

screens.layout: Top row grid of 2-3 stat cards (Total Users, Active Subs). Below, a list of users with pending payments (Approve/Reject buttons). Another tab or section for full user list with 'Delete' actions.

hero_empty_desk.alt: Orange folder on a black leather wallet on a clean desk surface

hero_passport_open.alt: An open passport with colorful ink stamps on a clean surface

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Material You / Expressive LIGHT personality using the defined color palette.

Implement the 'days remaining' (alarm threshold) chips using the status colors: error (2 days), warning (5 days), info (10 days), success (15 days). This satisfies the user's request for energetic, color-coded days.
Ensure all text is translated to Serbian Cyrillic as requested (e.g., Евиденција докумената, Лична карта, Пасош, Важи до, Истиче за).
Use Bricolage Grotesque or Outfit for headings and Manrope for body text, ensuring proper font-family linking and Cyrillic support.

Do NOT use any banned colors (indigo, violet, purple, navy, etc.) outside of the explicitly requested energetic blue/cyan. The palette is based on Orange (brand), Blue (brandSecondary), and semantic status colors.
Forms must have labels above inputs and a sticky primary CTA at the bottom over scrolling content.
Integrate the hero_passport_open image into the 'Subscription' screen or the Home empty state with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim to guarantee text readability.
In the Admin panel, provide clear visual distinction for users whose subscriptions are expiring soon.
Apply iOS-native glass effect on the bottom tab bar and sticky headers to modernize the design, as requested by the user's 'moderniji dizajn' prompt.
